notes.title: Playtest for Demo Build .9d
notes.notes:
As we wrap up work on the full version of the game (stay tuned for updates about the playtest for the full version! I'm aiming for it to be out in the next two weeks), I want to update the demo to keep it bug free and feeling good.

This update features more controller support updates as well as various typo and bug fixes.

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Build (.7c)
notes.notes: This update should fix an assortment of miscellaneous bugs! Additionally, the settings menu has been further adjusted and refined.
